parsed.name: 压力变送器
parsed.description: 用于实验系统中压力测量的压力变送器，可通过串口查询当前压力，并检查设备是否在线。证据指向 Omega PX409-485 压力变送器。
parsed.description_en: A pressure transducer used for pressure measurement in a laboratory system. It supports serial querying of the current pressure and checking whether the device is online. The evidence points to an Omega PX409-485 pressure transducer.

actions.description: 检查压力变送器是否在线
actions.description_en: Check whether the pressure transducer is online.
